steps: Opened candidate in actual editor via .lpp argument.
Selected Ethernet and zoomed to R17; agent observed 2.2 kOhm.
Sent Ctrl+S to the owned foreground GUI; UI reported Project saved! and circuit timestamp changed.
Closed owned GUI normally and started a new process on the saved candidate.
Selected Ethernet, zoomed to R17; agent again observed 2.2 kOhm.
Closed GUI normally; no lock remains; compared all bytes against the independently CLI- and GUI-saved unmodified control plus exact patch.
notes: GUI driven through Windows UI Automation and scoped input only to owned process; not a product GUI adapter.
UI Automation value-setting did not update Slint search; keyboard input and scoped mouse zoom worked.
Saved control adds four editor-preference files; every original source file is preserved except the intended candidate scalar.
No workspace libraries installed; embedded project libraries suffice to open/save this fixture.
